Disillusioned citizens express frustration at the politicisation of the violence.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Weekend riots and mass looting involving thousands of shops occurred across France following weeks of student protests. Groups of young people attacked police vans with hammers and machetes, while online sales platforms and police worked to track down looters.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The unrest has intensified political finger-pointing ahead of the presidential election in six months. Politicians and intelligence reports blamed hard-left groups for manipulating student demonstrations, while critics accused leaders of using the violence for political campaigns.
